verdict.rationale: Cloudflare docs mention durable Workflows and cron/queue integration (cloudflare-docs-9) and usage-based billing even for long agent workflows (cloudflare-docs-15), suggesting persistent, checkpointed execution. But community evidence directly contradicts this for agent workloads, noting CPU time limits (30s free, 15min paid) make Workers unsuitable for long-running agent tasks, pushing people to self-host instead (cloudflare-comm-9).
